title: Admin Culture Picker and the Content-Language Header | Orchard Core
description:
An editor can prefer to work in a language other than the one the site is published in.

The Admin Culture Picker adds a drop-down to the admin top bar, so you choose the culture of the admin pages in your browser. The Content Language Header adds a Content-Language header that names the language of the responses of the site.

In this video:
• What the Admin Culture Picker and the Content Language Header do
• Enabling both features on the Features page
• Adding a second supported culture so the picker appears
• Choosing the admin culture, and why the front end does not follow it
• What the Content-Language header carries
